name: openGym v1 Self-Hosted Workout Tracker
description: Plan routines, log workouts and track body weight on your own server.

PORT.description: Port nginx listens on (Railway's domain and healthcheck) and, in openGym's web image, also the API port it proxies /api to. Keep 8080 on both services.

NGINX_PORT.description: Port nginx listens on. Keep it equal to PORT.

BACKEND.description: Private host name of the openGym API service; /api is proxied to it.

RESOLVER.description: DNS server nginx uses to look up BACKEND. auto reads Railway's from /etc/resolv.conf.

OPENGYM_VERSION.description: openGym release for both services (web and API images, used as a build argument). Change it, then redeploy both.

MEDIA_UPLOAD_MAX.description: Largest photo or video upload nginx passes to the API (nginx size). Keep it above the API's MEDIA_VIDEO_MAX_MB (40).

OPENGYM_REAL_IP_HEADER.description: Header Railway's edge puts the visitor address in, so per-address sign-in limits count real visitors. off = every visitor counts as Railway's edge.

NGINX_WORKER_PROCESSES.description: nginx worker processes (1-64 or auto). auto would start one per host CPU, dozens on Railway.

PORT.description: Port the API listens on (private network and healthcheck). The openGym web service proxies to it; keep 8080 on both services.

DATA_DIR.description: Where openGym keeps everything (db.json, per-profile state, uploads, session key, push keys). Must stay on the /data volume.

RP_ID.description: Host name passkeys are bound to: the domain people open openGym on. Set it and ORIGIN to your custom domain if you add one.

ORIGIN.description: Full https address openGym is served from. Checked on every sign-in and sync; keep it in step with RP_ID.

RP_NAME.description: Name shown in the passkey prompt.

OPENGYM_OWNER_NAME.description: Profile name of the owner (admin) created on the first boot; you sign in with it. openGym cannot rename profiles, so pick your own name before deploying.

OPENGYM_OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Owner password, generated at deploy. Read on the first boot only; change it later in Settings, Account.

OPENGYM_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Optional e-mail the owner can sign in with instead of the name. openGym never sends mail to it.

INVITE_ONLY.description: 1 = new profiles need an invite code from the admin dashboard (sign-up closed). 0 opens sign-up to anyone with the URL.

ALLOW_GUEST.description: 0 hides 'Continue without account' (browser-only guest mode). 1 shows it.

PASSWORD_LOGIN.description: 1 = name or e-mail plus password sign-in next to passkeys. The owner needs it until they add a passkey.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Read the visitor address from the headers the openGym web service overwrites, for per-address sign-in limits. Keep 1.

SESSION_DAYS.description: How long a sign-in lasts, in days (openGym's default). Applies to new sign-ins only.

AUDIT_IP.description: Visitor addresses in the admin activity log: off, net (network only) or full.

DEFAULT_LANG.description: Optional default language for the sign-in screen and new profiles (en, de, es, fr, pt-BR, ...).

MEDIA_QUOTA_MB.description: Upload space per profile for exercise and workout photos and videos, in MB (0 = no cap).

MEDIA_MIN_FREE_MB.description: Uploads are refused when the volume has less free space than this, so workout saves never hit a full disk.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Optional contact for push services, e.g. mailto:you@example.com. Empty = ORIGIN.

COACH_DISABLED.description: 1 keeps the optional AI Coach off for good. With 0 it stays off until an admin connects a provider.

OPENGYM_VERSION.description: Follows OPENGYM_VERSION on the openGym service, so the API and web images are always the same release.
